The '''AR-0B damage reduction armor component''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] component developed by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The component generated an ablative energy current through a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] hull to reduce hull damage.
